hook: A superconducting spin switch reveals a weak ferromagnetic RuOx layer hidden at the Nb/RuO2 interface
hook_turn: reveals a weak ferromagnetic RuOx layer hidden at the Nb/RuO2 interface
summary: In a GdN/Nb/RuO2 trilayer, the superconducting transition of Nb shifts with interface exchange-field alignment, exposing magnetism that magnetometry cannot see. The authors attribute it to a thin RuOx layer formed when Nb pulls oxygen from RuO2, acting as a weak, magnetically hard ferromagnet. The layer's origin is an interpretation, and the probe works only at low temperature.
title: Hidden interfacial magnetism in RuO$_2$ heterostructures revealed by a superconducting spin switch
